idea-plugin.name: Labelixa ZPL
idea-plugin.description:
See the Zebra ZPL label you are editing — rendered, without a printer — and get the label checked with real line and column positions.
  • Preview the label under the cursor. Put the caret inside a ^XA … ^XZ block and run Labelixa: Preview Label Under Cursor. The block is rendered by the Labelixa API at the printer's real resolution and shown in the Labelixa Preview tool window.
  • Validate. Labelixa: Validate ZPL checks the whole file: unknown commands, unterminated fields, out-of-range parameters and more, each with its line and column and a link to the rule page. Findings that carry a fix offer it as a quick-fix.
  • Optional lint while typing (off by default) re-checks the file as you edit.
  • Syntax highlighting for .zpl files.
Works without an account (anonymous use is rate limited). An API key can be added in Settings → Tools → Labelixa and is kept in the IDE's password safe. Nothing is sent to the API until you run an action or turn on lint while typing.
